rubric_questions.title: 1. Join & Ductus Flow
rubric_questions.prompt: Do letters flow into one another as continuous pen movements, with natural reciprocal adaptation at boundaries (nu, nm, und, der)?

rubric_questions.title: 2. Bastarda Script Identity
rubric_questions.prompt: Do the letter shapes, thick/thin contrast, and feet/crowns read as authentic mid-15th-century German Bastarda?

rubric_questions.title: 3. Organic Hand Variation
rubric_questions.prompt: Across repeated minims and words, does the sample feel written by a living hand rather than stamped by a font?

rubric_questions.title: 4. Overall Stage Verdict
rubric_questions.prompt: Should this checkpoint be promoted to unlock the next curriculum stage?
